title: Akiyama Mizuki — It's All Over〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - School Festival
Stalls
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, I think this is it...!
Look, it says, “Handmade Cotton Candy”!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, I also see customers making their own cotton candy back there...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I was under the impression that making your own cotton candy would be really difficult, but it actually looks kind of fun.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, I've seen the cotton candy machine on that table before online. It's supposed to be really easy to use. All you have to do is pop in some sugar and let it go.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Huh? Just sugar?
That is pretty easy.

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line:
Welcome!
Are you here to make your own cotton candy?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, do you have room for four?

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line:
Yes, we do!
Let me show you to your seats.

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line:
...is how you use this machine.
I hope you all enjoy making your own cotton candy!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We will.
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Let's see... Once it's all warmed up, we toss in some flavored sugar and let it spin, right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So, are we really going to give each other the cotton candy we make...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Of course.
I mean, that'll make things way more interesting!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You think so? I don't mind, but who gets whose...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hmm... Good question...
I know! Why don't we just go clockwise?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ena, I'll give you mine. You give yours to Kanade. She'll give hers to Mafuyu, and I'll get yours, Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Which means I'll be making one for Mafuyu. I'm going to apologize in advance since it may not turn out well...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's okay. I won't mind.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I'm making one for Kanade...
Which flavor do you want?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? I don't have any preferences. Something simple...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Something simple... Then, maybe orange?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (They all seem pretty motivated now.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We have two machines. Who's going to go first...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I still don't feel very confident, so I'd like to watch someone else make one first.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Me too. I need more time to choose the right flavor for her.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Alright.
Then, Mafuyu, you and I are going first.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Do you have any preferences in terms of flavor, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Nope!
Pick whatever you think is best♪

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Then, I'll try making a strawberry one.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, I'll use this bluish stuff!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What? Don't make it taste weird, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Don't worry! It'll make it fizzy like cider♪ Our guide mentioned how it'd give it a more fun texture, remember?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay, just pop in the sugar and...
Switch it on!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, it's starting to produce little strings.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Don't just stare, Mizuki, Mafuyu!
You gotta gather them on your sticks!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Let's see... You're supposed to hover your stick over the center and twirl it, right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I think like this...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh wow... It's already starting to look like the cotton candy I've seen at other food stalls.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Mine's also coming along nicely.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm... Yeah, this does look pretty easy. All you really have to do is twirl the stick over the machine while it spins.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Now it's our turn, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Let's see... I have my stick, so all I have to do is pour in the sugar...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, here come the strings!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, now we just need to gather them on our sticks...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, Ena, you're going too fast!
You gotta go slower or it won't turn out right!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Huh? What do you mean?
Slower? How much slower?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I think you're going too slow, Kanade...
Try twirling your stick a little faster.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: O-Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Man, making cotton candy was super fun.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I kind of fumbled my way through it at first since I'd never done it before, but I'm glad it turned out okay.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You seem unsatisfied, Ena...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well, duh.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mine was becoming nice and big, but it totally lost its fluff when I bumped it up against the wall of the machine at the very end...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Didn't that happen because you tried to use up all the remaining sugar...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, you got greedy and made it too big. That's why it hit the wall.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I didn't want to let that sugar go to waste.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I'm really sorry, Kanade...
I wish it turned out better.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
It's okay.
I like the slightly orange hue of it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I've never had such a big stick of cotton candy before. I'm not sure I'll be able to finish it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, right. It seems like we're allowed to eat these here, so let's start digging in!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Here's yours, Ena!
Cotton candy with a fizzy feel made specially by yours truly.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm supposed to give you the one I made, right, Mafuyu? Here you are.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Here's yours, Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thanks, Mafuyu.
Oh, it's a touch of pink! That's so cute!
It's supposed to be strawberry flavored, right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes...
I also used some cherry-flavored sugar to expand its size a little.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Really?! Now this looks even more delicious. I can't wait to try it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It really is fun to hang out with the others like this...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ready...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki, Ena, Kanade & Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Let's eat!
Let's eat.
